Refined Indian watercolor with restrained gouache on warm ivory, quiet ochre, sage, dusty terracotta and muted indigo. Warm and gentle, consistent character design.
Canonical scene brief: The glowing palm leaf: beneath the bright first line, a second line of small Devanagari words is beginning to glow, the little vowel marks above and below the letters catching the light first. The words are small and soft-focus, with no legible text. Dhūmaka trembles, pointing at one word; Dādī leans in, spectacles on.

dadi: A warm, sharp-eyed grandmother in her seventies, silver hair in a low bun, round spectacles, a cream cotton sari with a thin maroon border and a grey shawl; carries a cloth-bound notebook.

The same text remains live app content. Do not substitute, omit, add or invent letters. No watermark, UI or extra labels.
